**Visual observations from test image:**
- Green mango leaf with dark brown/black irregular patches scattered across the surface
- Patches appear superficial, not causing major tissue death
- The leaf itself remains green; dark areas are irregular, blotchy deposits

**Matching against candidates:**
- **Sooty Mould**: Fits well — superficial dark black/brown encrustation on green leaf surface, irregular patches, not sunken lesions
- **Anthracnose**: Reference shows brown lesions mainly at margins on yellowing/young leaves — doesn't match
- **Bacterial Canker**: Reference shows serrated margin necrosis — doesn't match the test image

The test image strongly matches Sooty Mould reference (especially the bottom-right panel showing dark irregular patches on a green mango leaf).
